decisions.fixture: one class with two methods that each call the same helper, plus a free function that calls one of the methods — so a fold and an exact edge are both present and must not be confused
decisions.marking: a folded edge names the member it came through (matchedMembers) and an exact edge carries no mark
decisions.contrast: project scope reports applied=true with rowsFolded=0, which is the measurement that makes 'found nothing' different from 'never ran'
decisions.text: the JSON counters and the text reply must state the same number, so a caller who never asked for JSON is not told a different story

limitations: One fixture shape (a TypeScript class with method members); the fold's cap (`capped`) is not driven to its limit here.
The fold is asserted through the handler, which is the door a caller uses; the engine's own helper is not called directly.
